name: samuraizer-monorepo
description: Samuraizer monorepo: local-first meeting CLI + MCP server. Reference implementation of memnex.

scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @samuraizer/cli && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
scripts.release:check: npm run check && npm audit && npm run pack:dry-run
